lang.title: Zaɓi harshenka
lang.subtitle: Kana iya canza wannan a kowane lokaci a Saitunan.
tour.welcome.title: Barka da zuwa Shape.
tour.welcome.body: Ɗan gajeren yawo don ganin inda kowane abu yake — kusan daƙiƙa 30.
tour.home.title: Ranarka, a kallo ɗaya.
tour.home.body: Matakinka na gaba, abinci da ɗabi'u — duk a allon gida.
tour.train.title: Atisayen yau.
tour.train.body: Motsa jikinka, a shirye don farawa — kocinka ya rubuta shi, ko kai ka gina shi. Koci ba tilas ba ne.
tour.eat.title: Abinci da rubutawa.
tour.eat.body: Shirinka na yini. Danna abinci don rubuta shi da danna ɗaya.
tour.grocery.title: Jerin kayan kasuwa.
tour.grocery.body: Abincin makonka yana zama jerin sayayya, an tsara shi bisa sashe — an gina maka shi da kansa.
tour.habits.title: Ɗabi'un yau da kullum.
tour.habits.body: Yi alama a kan ƙananan abubuwan da suke taruwa — kowanne yana ciyar da Shape Score naka.
tour.chat.title: Kociyoyi da al'umma.
tour.chat.body: Aika saƙo ga kociyoyinka kuma ka ga labaran al'umma.
tour.you.title: Bayananka.
tour.you.body: Bayananka mai rai — hawanka, alamomi da duk abin da ka samu.
tour.progress.title: Yanayi da PR.
tour.progress.body: Nauyi, ƙarfi, barci, yawan aiki — cikakken hotonka, cikin jadawali.
tour.goal.title: Inda kake dosa.
tour.goal.body: Buri, matakai da kiyasin lokaci — alkawarin da ka yi wa kanka.
tour.score.title: Shape Score naka.
tour.score.body: Lamba ɗaya da take faɗin gaskiya — ka samu, ka kashe, ka hau matakai.
tour.radio.title: Shape Radio.
tour.radio.body: Waƙoƙin motsa jiki marasa tallace-tallace, an zaɓe su bisa BPM. Kyauta tare da zaman memba naka.
score.intro: Lamba ɗaya don bayyanarka. Duk abin da ka rubuta yana ciyar da ita — kuma tana hawa yayin da ka ci gaba da daidaito. Ga taƙaitaccen bayani.
score.tiers.head: Hau matakan
score.tiers.body: Ka samu maki don hawa — matakinka ba ya taɓa sauka da zarar ka kai shi.
score.earn.head: Hanyoyin samu
score.earn.compoundsBody: — riƙe ƙarfin gudunka sai kyautar mako ta girma. Shafin Score naka yana lissafa kowace hanyar samu.
score.spend.head: Kashe abin da ka samu
score.spend.body: Mai da maki zuwa kyaututtuka na gaske — kuɗin zama, kayan aiki da ƙari — a Shape Store. Kashewa ba ya taɓa rage matsayinka.
score.protect.head: Kare makinka
score.protect.body: Ka ci gaba da daidaito don ka riƙe su. Idan ka tsallake duba ko motsa jiki da ka yi alkawari, lambar tana sauka kaɗan — koci na iya yafe maka a kowane lokaci, kuma ba za ka taɓa sauka ƙasa da 0 ba.
dob.title: Tabbatar da ranar haihuwarka.
dob.subtitle: Manya masu shekaru 18 zuwa sama
dob.body: Shape na manya ne masu shekaru 18 zuwa sama, kuma kowane asusu yana bukatar a adana ranar haihuwa. Za a tambaye ka sau ɗaya kawai — ba za a iya canza ranar haihuwa ba daga baya, don haka duba ta kafin ka adana.
dob.label: Ranar haihuwa
dob.blockedTitle: Ba za mu iya kammala wannan a nan ba.
dob.blockedBody: Kafa asusunka bai kammala ba, don haka babu inda za a adana wannan tukuna. Tuntuɓi tallafi za mu gyara shi.
dob.genericError: An kasa adana ranar haihuwarka. Sake gwadawa.
dob.errInvalidDate: Shigar da ranar haihuwa mai inganci.
dob.errUnder18: Shape na manya ne masu shekaru 18 zuwa sama.
dob.errAlreadySet: An riga an adana ranar haihuwarka kuma ba za a iya canza ta a nan ba. Tuntuɓi tallafi idan ba daidai ba ce.
